question: The length of the shadow of a vertical tower is equal to its height. Find the angle of elevation.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the length of the shadow is equal to the height of the tower, the angle of elevation is found using the property of a 45° right triangle.

In such cases, tan θ = height ÷ shadow = 1.

⇒ θ = 45°.

**∴ Answer = 45°**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Height of tower = Length of shadow.

**Formula used:**

tan θ = height ÷ shadow.
